CustomField.description: Total bytes retained across every attachment file kept for this email (sum of byteSize across the retained list). Makes the oversized-email operational risk reportable — without it there is no way to ask how close real emails run to the heap/attachment ceilings before a broker's first-come-first-served claim could be lost.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populated by the attachment capture pipeline. Total retained bytes, not the vision-encoded size.
CustomField.label: Attachment Bytes
